name: glitchlab
description: MCP-first fault-injection campaign control, evidence tracking, analysis, and browser visualization.

interface.longDescription: GlitchLab gives Codex a standalone local MCP server and browser UI for configuring bounded hardware fault-injection campaigns, recording raw evidence, exploring parameter spaces, and building private target connectors.
defaultPrompt: Open GlitchLab in a new browser tab.
Help me create a connector for a new target.
Plan a safe discovery sweep for an unknown target.
